arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected originating from compromised internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), masquerading via partner VPN gateway IP 10.0.5.14. Attack began with Cobalt Strike beacon execution under user CORP\jsmith, followed by lateral movement attempts and targeted Kerberos TGT brute-forcing against domain controller 10.0.8.200. The source IP 10.0.5.14 has been blocked at the firewall. No evidence of domain compromise or data exfiltration was found during analysis. Post-incident actions include host isolation, user account reset, and detection rule refinement.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos TGT Request Volume from Non-DC Host
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4768
condition:
  - source_ip|cidr != '10.0.0.0/8'
  - destination_ip|cidr == '10.0.8.0/24'
  - user != 'NULL SID'
  - count() by source_ip > 50 within 5m
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate bulk account validation (rare)
description: Detects high-volume Kerberos TGT requests from non-trusted subnets, indicative of credential stuffing.
